#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;

struct Node;
struct Edge;

struct Node {
    int index;
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    Node() : index(-1) {}
};

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    Node* from;
    Node* to;
    ll flow;
    ll capacity;
    Edge* dual;
    ll cost;
    Edge(Node* s, Node* d, ll c, bool f, ll cost_ = 0) 
        : forward(f), from(s), to(d), flow(0), capacity(c), dual(nullptr), cost(cost_) {}
    ll remaining() { return capacity - flow; }
    void addFlow(ll amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node> nodes;
    MaxFlowSolver(int n = 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) addNode();
    }
    Node* addNode() {
        nodes.emplace_back();
        nodes.back().index = nodes.size() - 1;
        return &nodes.back();
    }
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, ll capacity, ll cost = 1) {
        Edge* e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true, cost);
        Edge* e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false, -cost);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
    }
    void link(int n1, int n2, ll capacity) {
        link(&nodes[n1], &nodes[n2], capacity);
    }
    virtual ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
    virtual ~MaxFlowSolver() {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver() : MaxFlowSolver(0) {}
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n) : MaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    virtual pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
};

struct Item {
    ll dist;
    int v;
    Item(ll d, int v) : dist(d), v(v) {}
    bool operator>(const Item& other) const {
        return dist > other.dist;
    }
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    ll minCost;
    EdmondsKarp() : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(0) {}
    EdmondsKarp(int n) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    pair<ll,ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        ll maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
    ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        int n = nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        ll flow = 0;
        ll cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0);
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;
            priority_queue<Item, vector<Item>, greater<Item>> que;
            que.push(Item(0, source));
            while (!que.empty()) {
                Item item = que.top(); que.pop();
                if (item.dist != dist[item.v]) continue;
                Node* vnode = &nodes[item.v];
                for (Edge* e : vnode->edges) {
                    ll temp = dist[item.v] + e->cost + potential[item.v] - potential[e->to->index];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[e->to->index] > temp) {
                        dist[e->to->index] = temp;
                        parent[e->to->index] = e;
                        que.push(Item(temp, e->to->index));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                if (parent[i] != nullptr) potential[i] += dist[i];
            ll augFlow = INF;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index)
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge* e = parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

int main() {
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &N, &M, &K, &C, &D);
    vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &people[i]);
        people[i]--;
    }
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    Node* src = solver.addNode();
    Node* snk = solver.addNode();
    int amt = 150;
    vector<vector<Node*>> timeNodes(N, vector<Node*>(amt, nullptr));
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; ++j) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], INF, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        scanf("%d%d", &a, &b);
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 1; j < amt-1; ++j) {
            int prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; ++k) {
                int cost = D * k * k - prev;
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j+1], 1, cost);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j+1], 1, cost);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    pair<ll,ll> ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    printf("%lld\n", ret.second);
    return 0;
}
